candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency, not the gateway itself (gateway /readyz stays 200).
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; whether order fails due to its own deps (inventory/payment/postgresql) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s pair with client-side 502s to server_address=order; gateway health endpoints return 200, so the fault originates downstream at order. Order's internal cause is not yet observed.
